description: This file defines a PHP class HomeViewTour that extends SugarView to render a tour page for the Home module in SuiteCRM, including logic regarding upgrade history and dynamic URL generation.

classes.name: HomeViewTour
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to manage the display of a home page tour, with logic to set up URLs based on upgrade status.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the tour template, dynamically assigns language strings, flavor, and possibly a calendar URL based on upgrade history.
